lessons.title: A comeback sends Xolos to the 2012 final
lessons.subtitle: Tijuana overturned a two-goal first-leg deficit against León in a charged semifinal return.

story.title: Back from León
story.body: After losing the first leg 2–0, Xolos returned to Estadio Caliente needing a response in the Apertura 2012 semifinal.

story.title: The turn
story.body: A 3–0 home win reversed the tie 3–2 on aggregate and sent Club Tijuana into its first top-flight final.

facts.label: Semifinal rival
facts.prompt: Which team did Xolos face in the Apertura 2012 semifinal return?
facts.scope: Apertura 2012 semifinal, second leg; 25 November 2012.
facts.evidence: The official match report identifies Club León as the semifinal opponent.

facts.label: Return-leg score
facts.prompt: What was the score in Xolos’s semifinal return against León?
facts.scope: Apertura 2012 semifinal return; 25 November 2012.
facts.evidence: Xolos won the home return 3–0.

facts.label: Aggregate result
facts.prompt: What aggregate score sent Xolos through to the Apertura 2012 final?
facts.scope: Apertura 2012 semifinal, two legs; 25 November 2012.
facts.evidence: The club says the return win produced a 3–2 aggregate victory after overturning a 2–0 first-leg loss.

lessons.title: Riascos rescues a point against Atlas
lessons.subtitle: A September 2012 equalizer kept Xolos unbeaten at home through five Apertura matches.

story.title: A difficult afternoon
story.body: Atlas took the lead at Estadio Caliente, but Riascos kept attacking and drew Xolos level late in the match.

story.title: A home draw
story.body: His 75th-minute finish made it 1–1 on September 22, 2012, in Apertura matchday nine.

facts.label: Opponent
facts.prompt: Which club did Riascos score against in Xolos’s 1–1 Apertura 2012 draw?
facts.scope: Apertura 2012, matchday 9; 22 September 2012.
facts.evidence: The official match report names Atlas as the opponent.

facts.label: Equalizing goal
facts.prompt: At what minute did Riascos score the equalizer against Atlas?
facts.scope: Apertura 2012, matchday 9; 22 September 2012.
facts.evidence: The club records Riascos’s equalizer in the 75th minute.

facts.label: Final score
facts.prompt: What was the final score between Xolos and Atlas?
facts.scope: Apertura 2012, matchday 9; 22 September 2012.
facts.evidence: The match ended level at 1–1.

lessons.title: A dated scoring mark in Morelia
lessons.subtitle: Riascos reached two personal Xolos milestones during a 1–1 draw on October 27, 2012.

story.title: A goal in the ninth minute
story.body: Riascos opened the scoring at Morelia on October 27, 2012, with his seventh league goal of that season.

story.title: A club scoring mark
story.body: That goal brought him to 12 Xolos goals across his first two top-flight campaigns, level with José Sand as the club’s leading Primera División scorers at the time.

facts.label: Season goal count
facts.prompt: Which season goal did Riascos score against Morelia on October 27, 2012?
facts.scope: Apertura 2012, matchday 15; as reported on 27 October 2012.
facts.evidence: The match report says the ninth-minute goal was Riascos’s seventh of the season.

facts.label: Two-campaign total
facts.prompt: How many Xolos goals had Riascos scored across his last two Primera División campaigns by this match?
facts.scope: Club Tijuana Primera División goals across two campaigns, through 27 October 2012.
facts.evidence: The report credits Riascos with 12 Xolos goals across the preceding two top-flight campaigns.

facts.label: Scoring comparison
facts.prompt: Which former Xolos forward did the club name alongside Riascos at that two-campaign scoring mark?
facts.scope: Club Tijuana Primera División scoring comparison, through 27 October 2012.
facts.evidence: The club said the 12-goal total put Riascos alongside former Xolos forward José Sand as the club’s top Primera División scorers at that point.

lessons.title: Saucedo’s Clausura 2012 goalkeeping record
lessons.subtitle: He was the least scored-on goalkeeper in the regular phase and received an award nomination.

story.title: A low-conceding campaign
story.body: In the Clausura 2012 regular phase, Saucedo appeared in all 17 matches and conceded 11 goals.

story.title: Across 19 appearances
story.body: Including the quarterfinals, he played 19 times and kept eight clean sheets. The federation named him among the candidates for the tournament’s goalkeeper award.

facts.label: Regular-phase distinction
facts.prompt: What goalkeeper distinction did Saucedo earn in the Clausura 2012 regular phase?
facts.scope: Club Tijuana; Clausura 2012 regular phase (17 matches).
facts.evidence: The club calls Saucedo the tournament’s least-scored-on goalkeeper in the regular phase.

facts.label: Clean sheets
facts.prompt: In how many of his 19 Clausura 2012 appearances did Saucedo keep a clean sheet?
facts.scope: Club Tijuana; Clausura 2012, regular phase and quarterfinals combined (19 appearances).
facts.evidence: The club says he kept eight clean sheets in 19 appearances across the regular phase and quarterfinal series.

facts.label: Award shortlist
facts.prompt: For which individual award was Saucedo nominated after Clausura 2012?
facts.scope: Clausura 2012 award nominations.
facts.evidence: The club says Saucedo was among the candidates for the Clausura 2012 goalkeeper Balón de Oro.

lessons.title: A first captain’s armband at match 66
lessons.subtitle: Saucedo led Xolos for the first time in a 2–0 home win during Clausura 2013.

story.title: A milestone match
story.body: Saucedo started in goal against Atlante in Clausura 2013, his 66th appearance for Club Tijuana.

story.title: First time as captain
story.body: He wore the Xolos captain’s armband for the first time as the team won 2–0 and recorded its third clean sheet of that campaign.

facts.label: Club appearance
facts.prompt: How many Xolos appearances had Saucedo made when he first wore the captain’s armband?
facts.scope: Club Tijuana vs Atlante, Clausura 2013, matchday 8.
facts.evidence: The match report calls this Saucedo’s 66th game as a Xoloitzcuintle.

facts.label: Leadership milestone
facts.prompt: What did Saucedo do for the first time in that match?
facts.scope: Club Tijuana vs Atlante, Clausura 2013, matchday 8.
facts.evidence: The club says he wore the captain’s armband for the first time in his 66th appearance.

facts.label: Match result
facts.prompt: What was the final score of the match in which Saucedo first captained Xolos?
facts.scope: Club Tijuana vs Atlante, Clausura 2013, matchday 8.
facts.evidence: Xolos defeated Atlante 2–0.

lessons.title: A free kick in Arce’s 401st league appearance
lessons.subtitle: Arce scored from distance in Xolos’s Apertura 2012 opening win over Puebla.

story.title: A milestone opener
story.body: On July 20, 2012, Xolos began Apertura with a 2–0 victory over Puebla. Arce opened the scoring from a free kick.

story.title: A landmark appearance
story.body: The goal came in Arce’s 401st Primera División match, making a league-career milestone part of the club’s first win of the tournament.

facts.label: League appearance
facts.prompt: In which Primera División appearance did Arce score against Puebla?
facts.scope: Apertura 2012, matchday 1; 20 July 2012.
facts.evidence: The report identifies it as Arce’s 401st Primera División match.

facts.label: Goal minute
facts.prompt: At what minute did Arce score his free kick against Puebla?
facts.scope: Apertura 2012, matchday 1; 20 July 2012.
facts.evidence: The club reports that Arce’s direct free kick opened the score in the 12th minute.

facts.label: Final score
facts.prompt: What was the final score in Xolos’s Apertura 2012 opener against Puebla?
facts.scope: Apertura 2012, matchday 1; 20 July 2012.
facts.evidence: The official report lists the match as Club Tijuana 2–0 Puebla.

lessons.title: Arce scores in Xolos’s first top-flight win
lessons.subtitle: His goal helped deliver a 3–1 victory away to Santos in August 2011.

story.title: A first win
story.body: Xolos earned their first victory in Mexico’s top division on August 6, 2011, away to Santos Laguna.

story.title: Arce on the scoresheet
story.body: Arce scored in the 43rd minute as Club Tijuana rallied to a 3–1 result in Torreón.

facts.label: Opponent
facts.prompt: Against which club did Xolos earn their first Primera División win?
facts.scope: First top-flight victory; Apertura 2011, matchday 4; 6 August 2011.
facts.evidence: The club identifies Santos as the opponent in its first Primera División victory.

facts.label: Arce goal minute
facts.prompt: At what minute did Arce score in Xolos’s first top-flight win?
facts.scope: First top-flight victory; Apertura 2011, matchday 4; 6 August 2011.
facts.evidence: The match account lists Arce’s goal at 43 minutes.

facts.label: Final score
facts.prompt: What was the score when Xolos beat Santos in their first Primera División victory?
facts.scope: First top-flight victory; Apertura 2011, matchday 4; 6 August 2011.
facts.evidence: The official match history records Santos 1–3 Club Tijuana.
